# Audiospatials

> Audiospatials is a catalyst of creativity. We make records with independent artists, from folk to techno. A studio in Santa Cruz and Los Angeles, run by Gregor Egan and Hunter Bowersmith.

Audiospatials is the collaborative project of Gregor Egan (Los Angeles) and Hunter Bowersmith (Santa Cruz). It releases records by its artists and works with independent artists on production, recording, mixing. Contact: hello@audiospatials.com.

## Pages

- [Artists](https://audiospatials.com/artists): the roster
- [Music](https://audiospatials.com/music): records released on Audiospatials, and videos
- [Studio](https://audiospatials.com/studio): what we do, and recent work with credits
- [About](https://audiospatials.com/about): how it started
- [Contact](https://audiospatials.com/contact): send a project

## Artists

- [LUCI](https://audiospatials.com/luci): Berlin DJ, originally from California and formed in the Lyon underground. Dark, hypnotic sets drawn from post-rock and goth.
- [kröw](https://audiospatials.com/krow): Minimal house and deep tech DJ with Chicago and San Francisco roots. Played Lollapalooza 2023.
- [FENNEC](https://audiospatials.com/fennec): A Santa Cruz band blending rock, folk and electronic sound, led by Hunter Bowersmith.
- [Gregor Egan](https://audiospatials.com/gregor-egan): LA producer and DJ. Hypnotic, textural techno shaped by jazz training and Chicago house.
- [Canary](https://audiospatials.com/canary): Canary is an artist on Audiospatials.
- [Margo Flow](https://audiospatials.com/margo-flow): New York City singer-songwriter. Folk and pop about the inner world and the natural one.
- [John Bear](https://audiospatials.com/john-bear): Santa Cruz folk songwriter, originally from Birmingham, Alabama. Blueberry Pie EP out on Audiospatials.
- [Stäzrad](https://audiospatials.com/stazrad): A folk song that turns hardcore. Emo, prog and finger-picked acoustic songs from a Bay Area artist born in St. Louis.
- [WOLFMANWOOF](https://audiospatials.com/wolfmanwoof): Two producers, one from techno and one from experimental synth-rock, meeting in between. Moonrise EP out now.
